children: Insteel Industries declared regular and special cash dividends totaling $1.03 per share, payable December 11, 2026.
The $0.03-per-share quarterly dividend and $1.00-per-share special dividend apply to common stock.
Shareholders of record as of November 27, 2026, are eligible for both dividends.
The company said the special dividend reflects confidence in its financial position and long-term outlook.
Insteel said the distribution balances shareholder returns with resources for operating needs, capital investments and growth opportunities.
